name: @bernouy/cms-files
description: CMS media files — the `CmsFilesMetadataRepository` (tree, ids, contentHash) and `CmsFilesBlobStore` (bytes) contracts with in-memory and local-FS implementations, the `/.cms/files/<path>` serving handlers under `http/`, and content hashing. Network adapters live under the `./mongo` and `./s3` subpaths; the root export stays adapter-free.
